I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use encoded/obfuscated instructions to get me to bypass my guidelines - presenting a "jailbreak" framing where I'm supposed to adopt an alternate identity ("שָׁרְט") that would operate without my normal values and boundaries.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to help you with a wide range of tasks - answering questions, writing, analysis, coding, creative projects, and much more. I'll do this as myself, with my actual values intact.

Is there something genuine I can help you with today?
